tools.name: get_crisis_help
tools.description: The real emergency number and crisis lines for a country. Use FIRST, before any other tool, when someone speaks of harming themselves or others or is in danger. Never defaults to a country: ask if unknown. Example: {country:"Kenya"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/get_crisis_help. Access: no sign-

tools.name: discover_living_bread
tools.description: The front door: turns a request in the person's own words and language into the need underneath and the real experiences that meet it. Use whenever you are unsure which tool fits ("I feel alone", "I just moved"). Example: {query:"I just moved and want friends who share my faith"}. Full guide: living

tools.name: read_scripture
tools.description: Read the Bible word for word from a stored text, never from memory. Modes: passage, context, search, compare, original_words, cross_references, verify, translations, which_translation, languages, explained. Use when you know the reference or the words. Example: {mode:"passage", reference:"John 3:16"

tools.name: find_scripture_for
tools.description: Verses for a feeling, a topic, the words of Jesus, or today, read verbatim from the stored text. Modes: need, topic, words_of_jesus, daily_bread. Use when the person names a situation but no reference. Example: {mode:"need", subject:"my mother died"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_scripture_

tools.name: learn_the_faith
tools.description: The house's own pages on the faith: the gospel, beliefs, parables, miracles, hymns, a prayer for a situation, a hard season, saints, the church year, the meaning of a name, other faiths. Pick a mode. Example: {mode:"a_prayer_for", subject:"a friend who is sick"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/lea

tools.name: find_churches
tools.description: Real churches and congregations near a place, nearest first, or one church by id. Modes: near, by_id. City level only. Example: {mode:"near", city:"Seattle"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_churches. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

tools.name: find_gatherings
tools.description: Real gatherings of Christians near a place: any, tonight, this week. Real rows only, with freshness. Example: {mode:"tonight", city:"Austin"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_gatherings. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

tools.name: find_people_to_pray_with
tools.description: Real doors to pray with other people: someone now, the Watch tonight, live tables, prayers left near you, hear the Kingdom pray, ask the family. Never promises anyone will answer. Example: {mode:"ask_the_family"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_people_to_pray_with. Access: no sign-in; shared

tools.name: find_ways_to_serve
tools.description: Verified ways to serve: near a place, public needs, or a neighbor. Real, city level. Example: {mode:"near", city:"Nairobi"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_ways_to_serve. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

tools.name: find_communities
tools.description: Christian communities to join, universities, or a family for someone lonely or new, with an honest empty. Example: {mode:"to_join", city:"Seattle"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_communities. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

tools.name: see_the_kingdom
tools.description: The Body of Christ in motion, read only: the map, today's activity, testimonies, worship, sermons, live church services, Living Rooms, songs, games. Example: {mode:"sermons"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/see_the_kingdom. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

tools.name: start_with_christ
tools.description: Begin: the tour (begin), next steps for a journey, reading plans, a plan for a need, or an invitation to bring one person. Example: {mode:"begin"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/start_with_christ. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Kingdom (results), ask a free-form question about Christianity (answer), look up a protocol urn, or discover. Example: {mode:"answer", query:"Who is Jesus?"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/search. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one item by the id a search returned. Full guide: living-bread://tools/fetch. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.
